stories.title: US proposes 25% tariff on Indian imports, possible reduction to 17% with trade deal
stories.summary: The United States has proposed a 25% tariff on imports from India, citing excess industrial capacity. The rate could be lowered to 17% if the two countries reach a trade agreement. India’s trade ministry is reviewing the U.S. allegations and defending its position as negotiations remain prolonged due to tariff rules and recent military incidents.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: North Korea orders Swiss diplomat to leave over sanctions on children’s camp
stories.summary: North Korea declared the head of Switzerland’s diplomatic office in Pyongyang persona non grata and gave him 48 hours to depart, also demanding the mission’s closure. The action follows Switzerland’s decision to sanction the Songdowon international children’s camp in Wonsan, which hosts Russian, Chinese and other children and has been accused of moving children from Russian‑occupied areas of Ukraine. KCNA described the Swiss sanctions as a “blatant hostile act.”
stories.why: The expulsion narrows diplomatic channels between the two countries, complicating the management of sanctions and any humanitarian coordination linked to the camp.

stories.title: Net FDI to India negative $4.95 bn in September, RBI says
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported that net foreign direct investment to India in September 2023 was a net outflow of US $4.95 billion. The negative balance was attributed to a slowdown in incoming investment flows and higher capital outflows during the month.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.
